services.title: UPSC Civil Services Examination (IAS / IPS / IFS)
services.description: Detailed Application Form (DAF) document verification for India’s highest administrative and foreign services.
steps: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) on UPSC portal with valid Aadhaar & active phone.
Upload Matriculation (10th) certificate as absolute legal proof of Date of Birth.
Submit Graduation Degree Certificate or Bonafide Final Year certificate from authorized Registrar.
Upload Central Govt format OBC-NCL / EWS / SC / ST caste certificate issued in prescribed financial year.
commonPitfalls: Spelling differences in candidate name between 10th marksheet and Degree certificate.
OBC-NCL certificate issued after the cutoff date of the preliminary exam notification.

services.title: Aadhaar Name / DOB / Address Demographic Update
services.description: Correct demographic spelling, update mobile number, or update address on your 12-digit official Aadhaar card.
steps: Login to myAadhaar portal using your Aadhaar number and OTP.
Select the field to update (Name, DOB, Gender, or Address).
Upload supporting document (10th Marksheet for DOB, Passport/PAN for Name, Electricity Bill/Rent Agreement for Address).
Pay online fee of ₹50 and track the URN (Update Request Number).
commonPitfalls: Uploading blurry or cropped document photos resulting in rejection by UIDAI automated verifier.
Name changes exceeding 2 lifetime attempts without Gazette notification.

services.title: Fresh Passport Application (Tatkaal & Normal PSK)
services.description: Apply for a fresh 36-page Indian passport via Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) with biometric verification.
steps: Create an account on Passport Seva portal and fill the application form.
Pay appointment fee and schedule visit to nearest PSK or POPSK.
Carry original physical documents along with 2 self-attested photocopies.
Undergo biometric capture at PSK, followed by local Police Verification at your registered address.
commonPitfalls: Address proof mismatch between Aadhaar and present living address.
Non-ECR (Emigration Check Not Required) status requires submission of 10th/Higher Education passing certificate.

services.title: PAN Card Application & Aadhaar Linkage (NSDL / UTIITSL)
services.description: Apply for a new Permanent Account Number or link PAN with Aadhaar as mandated by Income Tax Department.
steps: Go to the e-Filing portal ➔ Quick Links ➔ "Link Aadhaar".
Enter PAN and Aadhaar number to check linkage status.
If not linked, pay statutory penalty fee of ₹1,000 via e-Pay Tax on NSDL.
Submit Aadhaar OTP request to complete biometric authentication.
commonPitfalls: Name or Date of Birth discrepancy between PAN database and UIDAI database causing validation failure.

services.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP Central & State Schemes)
services.description: Centralized financial aid and tuition fee reimbursement for meritorious, minority, and SC/ST/OBC students.
steps: Generate OTR (One Time Registration) using Aadhaar Face Auth or Mobile OTP.
Fill family income details and upload valid Tehsildar-signed Income Certificate.
Link your Bank Account with Aadhaar (NPCI Aadhaar Seeding is mandatory).
Submit the application and download the verification slip for college endorsement.
commonPitfalls: Bank account is not NPCI-seeded with Aadhaar, causing Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) payment failure.
Income certificate validity expired before the application verification date.

services.title: Learner & Permanent Driving Licence (Sarathi Parivahan)
services.description: Apply for Learner Licence and Driving Smart Card via Ministry of Road Transport (MoRTH) contactless portal.
steps: Visit Parivahan portal ➔ Select State ➔ "Apply for Learner Licence (LL)".
Authenticate with Aadhaar e-KYC for contactless exam without visiting RTO.
Appear for online road safety test from home.
After 30 days of LL, book slot for physical driving test at RTO for Permanent DL.
commonPitfalls: Candidate age must be strictly 18+ on date of application for four-wheeler and geared two-wheeler.

Transfer Certificate (TC).source: Previous School / Junior College Administration Office
Transfer Certificate (TC).nextStep: Submit a written request along with your 12th board marksheet photocopy to the School Principal / Registrar office.

Migration Certificate.source: CBSE / State Board Online Portal / DigiLocker
Migration Certificate.timeline: Instant on DigiLocker / 5 Days via Postal Dispatch
Migration Certificate.nextStep: Download verified digital Migration Certificate from DigiLocker or apply through your board’s student service portal.

Gap Year Affidavit.nextStep: Visit any Notary public with Aadhaar and 12th marksheet to draft a Gap Year Affidavit stating you took a study drop year.

Medical Fitness Certificate.source: Registered Medical Practitioner (Govt Hospital / MBBS Doctor)
Medical Fitness Certificate.nextStep: Download your college’s prescribed medical proforma (e.g. JoSAA Annexure 7) and get it stamped by an MBBS doctor.

Income Certificate.nextStep: Apply online on your state e-District portal with salary slips/ITR and ration card for fee concession and scholarships.

Domicile.nextStep: Submit 10 years proof of residence (Electricity bill / Ration card / School certificates) on state citizen portal.

Caste Certificate.nextStep: Apply on state revenue portal with family lineage caste proof. Central format is mandatory for IITs/AIIMS/UPSC.

Valid Passport.source: Passport Seva Kendra (Ministry of External Affairs)
Valid Passport.nextStep: Book appointment on passportindia.gov.in with 10th marksheet (DOB proof) and Aadhaar (Address proof).
